citations.assessment: The source has Rav Naḥman bar Adda transmitting the interpretation about loosely set bricks in Shemuel’s name.
The Bavli expands the patronym to bar Rav Adda and again gives Shemuel as transmitter; the subject is the festival eruv.
The paired attributions to Naḥman bar Adda and Naḥman the elder stand together.
